name: text-field
title: TextField
description: TanStack Form text field composed with Keystone form-control semantics and Mason styling hooks.

meta.customization: Use mason-text-field classes and data-part values for root, label, input, description, and error while TanStack Form owns field state.

parity.tanstackForm: First-class comparison is TanStack Form: the component binds field state to an input with Mason label/description/error parts. Gaps: async validation examples, schema adapters, field arrays, submit lifecycle helpers, and masked/parsed value patterns remain follow-up work.
parity.baseUi: Tracks Base UI Field/Input depth for ARIA relationships, invalid/required/disabled state, native form participation, and validation messaging. Gaps: touched/dirty/filled/focused state, form-level validation orchestration, and control registration depth remain follow-up work.
parity.kobalte: Solid reference is Kobalte TextField/FormControl composition. Gaps: context-driven ID registration depth, reset listener behavior, and richer description/error composition remain follow-up work.
